description: This file defines abstract and concrete implementations of grain timers within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes timer management, callback invocation, error handling, and context validation logic.

classes.name: GrainTimer
classes.description: An abstract class implementing core timer functionality for Orleans grains, including scheduling, invoking callbacks, handling errors, and managing timer state.

classes.name: GrainTimer<T>
classes.description: A generic subclass of GrainTimer that accepts a callback with a state parameter, providing typed callback invocation.

classes.name: InterleavingGrainTimer
classes.description: A specialized GrainTimer with interleaving callback execution, managing a callback and an optional state object.

methods.name: Change
methods.description: Updates the timer's due time and period, optionally deferring the change if the timer is firing.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels and disposes of the timer, and notifies the timer registry.

methods.name: InvokeCallbackAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to invoke the timer callback asynchronously, implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: InvokeGrainTimerCallbackAsync
methods.description: Handles invocation of the callback, manages success/failure, and schedules the next tick.

methods.name: OnTickCompleted
methods.description: Schedules the next timer tick after the current callback completes.
